text: 1.1 General requirements(1) Applicants must abide by the laws and regulations of China and the rules and regulations of the university, and respect Chinese social customs.(2) Applicants should be healthy, both physically and psychologically, with no criminal record, and meet the physical standards required for applying for a student visa or residence permit.1.2 Age and identification requirements(1) Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with valid passports.(2) Applicants who are residents of Chinese mainland, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Macao Special Administrative Region and Taiwan Region and have obtained foreign nationality, or whose parents are both Chinese nationals and have both settled abroad, or one of whose parents is a Chinese national and has settled abroad, and who have acquired foreign nationality at birth, should meet the requirements specified in Notice of the Ministry of Education on standardizing the acceptance of international students in Chinese universities (No.12 issued in 2020).(3) Those who apply as international students should have had a valid foreign passport or proof of nationality document for at least four years and had a record of actual residence in a foreign country for at least two years from May 1st, 2021 to April 30th, 2025. Actual residence in a foreign country for nine months out of a year can be counted as one year, based on entry and exit stamps.(4) Residents of Chinese mainland, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Macao Special Administrative Region and Taiwan Region who apply as international students after immigrating and acquiring foreign nationality must have acquired foreign nationality before May 1st, 2021, and had a record of actual residence in a foreign country for at least two years from May 1st, 2021, to April 30th, 2025. Actual residence in a foreign country for nine months out of a year may be counted as one year, based on entry and exit stamps.(5) Applicants should be aged between 18 and 35 years. (Scholarship applicants must meet the age requirements of each program).1.3 Academic requirements(1) Equal to high school qualification (or above) in China;(2) Full transcripts of final education, original or notarized version, in notarized Chinese or English Translation.1.4 Language proficiencyApplicants should hold an HSK (Level 5) certificate, and those who apply for a bachelor's degree in Chinese Language should obtain an HSK (Level 4) certificate after February 2023.1.5 Financial conditionApplicants should be able to pay tuition fees, accommodation and related daily living expenses.
